components.name: M5 Whole Health
components.description: A free, open-source health record app that runs entirely in the browser. It answers a check-in request from the patient's own records, with per-item consent; nothing leaves the browser except the encrypted answer.
components.notes: Click “Load the synthetic test patient” if the wallet shows no records. Shares US Core and coverage records as imported, matched by declared profile, with per-item consent; answers inline forms such as the PHQ-2. Does not issue SMART Health Cards or support the large-response scenario. Runs entirely in the browser; nothing is stored or sent except the encrypted answer.
